intro.text: A lighteyed Shardbearer and Highprince Thanadal's Royal Defender, in the Alethi warcamps.

items.text: After Thanadal criticised Dalinar, Adolin challenged Resi to a 'friendly' duel that drew a packed arena. Resi favoured Stonestance, but Adolin's quicker Windstance pressed him onto the defensive. When Resi tried another heavy blow, Adolin caught it on his vambrace and shattered Resi's thigh plate, leaving him unable to move. Resi swore loudly at his loss.
Resi was among the Shardbearers guarding a meeting of the highprinces after the Assassin in White attacked Dalinar.

personality.text: Thanadal's 'star' Shardbearer: vengeful, stubborn and imposing, and furious when he loses a duel.
